title: Okapi_Library
description: Arduino library for the Okapi ATmega1284p-based data logger. Manages logging, power, telemetry, and on-board sensing, with support for solar charging, Particle Boron telemetry, external interrupt counting, RTC-driven sleep/wake cycles, and SD-card data logging.

creators.name: Wickert, Andrew D.
creators.affiliation: University of Minnesota, Department of Earth & Environmental Sciences
